name: sls.linear_mps
desc: Safely-limited linear speed of the commanded motion (today: TokenConstraints.max_linear_speed_mps)

name: sls.angular_rps
desc: Safely-limited angular speed of the commanded motion (today: TokenConstraints.max_angular_speed_rps)

name: step.max_duration_s
desc: Longest time one skill call may hold its permit (today: TokenConstraints.max_duration_sec)

name: sls.gait_mps
desc: Safely-limited walking speed of a legged base

name: sls.joint_rps
desc: Safely-limited joint speed (per joint, the largest one is measured)

name: slp.zone
desc: Allowed zone of the site model — a positioning feed, not a number; judged by the issuer's site model

name: ssm.separation_m
desc: Measured separation distance to the nearest person (lower bound; the speed=f(distance) curve stays with the safety function)

name: sdh.human_distance_m
desc: Measured distance to the nearest person, reported by the robot's safety layer (lower bound)

name: sdr.robot_distance_m
desc: Measured distance to the nearest other robot, reported by the fleet or adapter (lower bound)

name: sfc.contact_n
desc: Measured contact force at the effector (upper bound; the body-region table stays with the safety function)
